# Marketing Skills Tools Upstream

This directory contains shared tool registry, CLI, Composio, and integration documentation vendored from `coreyhaines31/marketingskills` so the installed marketing skills' relative links keep working.

- Upstream: https://github.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills
- Vendored commit: `dc7fea85bfc389140cafa844ff380e180211e46d`
- License: MIT, preserved in `LICENSE`

The JavaScript CLI files are upstream examples and references for marketing-tool workflows. They are not Ariadne product integrations unless a later documented slice selects and validates one.
